R501.note: Primary array-based Runtime.exec(cmdArray) correctly closes shell injection, but the offered 'more concise' alternative builds the array with null entries on non-Windows (cmd.exe/dir branch nulls), which throws NullPointerException from exec() at runtime if adopted.

R502.note: Clean parameterized query via mysql2 '?' placeholder; status codes and response shape unchanged.

R503.note: Generic message replaces leaked error.message/stack while keeping the pre-existing logger.error(error) call and 500 status; consistent with app's own fallback handler.

R504.note: Allowlist regex blocks path-traversal/separator characters before the require, throwing on invalid input; no other behavior altered.

R505.note: Swaps Math.random() for crypto.randomBytes(); only changes the opaque invite-code's character format/length, which nothing else in the file depends on.

R506.note: markupsafe.escape() only neutralizes HTML entities (< > & " '), not Jinja delimiters; since page_html is concatenated user data passed as the template *source* to render_template_string(), a query.term containing '{{ ... }}' still executes as server-side template injection despite escaping -- the write-up's claim that this prevents Jinja2 template injection is incorrect.
